turns.instruction:
Build the attached 12 m parallel-chord Warren-type truss in the global X-Z plane with six 2 m panels and a constant 2 m height. B0 through B6 are at x=0,2,4,6,8,10,12 m and z=0; T0 through T6 are directly above them at z=2 m. Connect adjacent nodes along both chords, provide every vertical Bi-Ti including the two end verticals, and use exactly the alternating diagonals B0-T1, T1-B2, B2-T3, T3-B4, B4-T5, T5-B6. All 25 members are pin-jointed axial-only rods with the supplied steel material and common area. B0 is pinned; B6 is a bilateral vertical roller free in global X. Case D applies 8 kN downward in global -Z at each internal bottom node B1 through B5 only. Run first-order linear static analysis using OpenSees, with self-weight disabled. Report signed ux and uz at all five loaded bottom nodes, signed axial force N in all six diagonals and seven verticals, and Fx/Fz support reactions at B0 and B6. Positive N is tension. Label every result with its node/member ID, load case D and unit.

Execute OpenSees; complete every output in input.md and check equilibrium. Clarify essential gaps or conflicts first.
